evals.name: forbidden-phrases-and-em-dash
evals.prompt: Run a style-guide check on a sentence stacking four banned stock phrases (furthermore, it is well established that, as such, therefore), a doubled modifier (clearly and unambiguously), a spaced em dash, and a passive construction.
evals.expected_output: Flags every banned phrase and the doubled modifier by name, fixes the em-dash spacing, and returns a corrected version with none of the flagged issues present.
expectations: Flags 'it is well established that' as prohibited
Flags the doubled modifier 'clearly and unambiguously'
Flags and fixes the spaced em dash
The corrected version contains none of the above issues

notes: Pilot regression eval added 2026-08-19 (delegation-batch Task #11) to test the pre-existing forbidden-phrase list and the new em-dash Typography rule (claude.md v0.9.0, Task #8) together, since this skill is the one meant to enforce both.
